architecture_risks: No locale resolution or preference layer is visible in current source; root html lang is hardcoded to id.
Route groups yield overlapping paths (including legacy /murid and public/auth routes), so use Next route manifests to validate URL uniqueness and guards.
Student shared shell mounts PushPermissionInit while admin shell overlays OpsAiDrawer; language menu placement must avoid mounting student consent UI on admin.
The source tree exposes 136 route handlers; localized visible errors must preserve protocol shapes and stable machine codes.
Auth provider screens, MCP/OAuth contracts, signed links and uploaded/authored academic content have explicit third-party or machine/source-language boundaries.
Current static page route set is larger than the CP6 finite allowlist; dynamic blog/form/demo and protected routes need explicit URL policy before adding locale prefixes.

implementation_snapshot.known_pending_verification: CP7 remains partial only for data-dependent and breadth boundaries: populated demo content and some synthetic PKA enrollment data are unavailable; the complete 307-record route/role/state matrix is not exercised; and live external-provider and request-time cache behavior were not validated. The primary reviewer accepted 26 focused state screenshots (22 non-MCP plus 4 new MCP) and the 52 public captures, for 78 SHA-256 records in the accepted manifest. The focused Playwright suite passed 20 cases and skipped 2; the boundary suite passed 4 and skipped 2 unavailable PKA fixtures; the metadata browser suite passed all 8 checks. The early loading-overlay capture is handled through reduced-motion emulation in test setup. Zyra conversation overrides are memory-only for up to 32 conversations and clear on drawer remount, reload, account, course, or interface-locale change; the account interface locale persists across visits.
